note: Thresholds are copied verbatim from the pre-registration and were not changed. Pass rules are applied to point estimates of pooled recognisable rates. Intervals are reported next to them. The primary SecAgg+ setting is max_weight 1000 (the upstream default, fixed before the 8-client run). 30 evaluation seeds (0 to 29), 8 victim images per seed.

S1.prediction: At 8 clients the aggregate view stays at the floor
S1.pass_rule: Recognisable rate at most floor plus 5 points
S1.operationalisation: Floor is the class-average label floor on the same victim images. The aggregate view is the SecAgg+ aggregate with joint-oracle labels. Pass uses point estimates. The aggregate is far BELOW the floor, so S1 passes because the attack is weak on 64 joint images, not because of any guarantee.

S2.prediction: n-1 collusion stays at plaintext level at 4 and 8 clients
S2.operationalisation: n-1 collusion on the primary max_weight 1000 view at 4 and 8 clients. Both counts must reach 85 percent.

S1_at_4_clients_for_reference.prediction: At 8 clients the aggregate view stays at the floor
S1_at_4_clients_for_reference.pass_rule: Recognisable rate at most floor plus 5 points

S3.pass_rule: Peak container memory below 6 GB. If not, the 8-client run is dropped and recorded as such
